text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"people","kind":"count","span":"help 2 people per hour"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"hours","kind":"count","span":"for 3 hours a day"},{"id":"q3","value":20,"unit":"percent","kind":"count","span":"takes 20% of the days off"},{"id":"q4","value":31,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"there are 31 days in March"},{"id":"q5","value":19,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"between March 1st and April 19th"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q4","q5"],"out":"s1","note":"days in March plus the day-of-month for April 19 gives the total number of days from March 1 to April 19"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"people helped per hour times hours per day gives people helped per working day"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"relates total days to the 20 percentage figure representing the days taken off (symbolic, not a literal multiplication by 20)"},{"op":"sub","args":["s1","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"total days minus days off gives working days"},{"op":"mul","args":["s4","s2"],"out":"s5","note":"working days times people helped per day gives total people helped"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of people Billy helps between March 1st and April 19th"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"the '1' in 'March 1st' is a calendar date label marking the start date, not a quantity used in the day-count or rate calculations"}]}
